mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM chat_message_resources r JOIN chat_session_messages m ON m.id=r.message_id WHERE r.user_id=#{user} AND m.user_id=#{user} AND m.session_id=#{session} AND m.superseded_at IS NULL AND r.storage_key=#{storageKey}

SELECT r.id AS "resourceId",r.file_name AS "fileName",r.mime_type AS "mimeType",r.file_size AS "fileSize" FROM chat_message_resources r JOIN chat_session_messages m ON m.id=r.message_id WHERE r.user_id=#{user} AND m.user_id=#{user} AND m.session_id=#{session} AND m.superseded_at IS NULL ORDER BY m.sequence_no DESC,r.created_at LIMIT 100
